title: Montage / recap — du lịch, sự kiện, khai trương, hậu trường, thương hiệu
summary: Music is the script: cuts on the beats (every one or two), energy built in sections that follow the track, speed ramps into the big moments, one or two words on screen at most, the place and the date as quiet labels.
signals: many short clips of varied places, people and moments

runtime.why: A montage lives as long as its music section; end on the peak.

hook.purpose: the most spectacular moment, cut hard on the first beat
hook.graphics: a two-to-four word title, or nothing

structure.purpose: establish the place and the mood; wider shots, two beats per cut
people and action, one beat per cut, speed ramps into the hits
the best moments on the music's drop
structure.graphics: stat (numbers of the event) if real

structure.purpose: a calm last shot and the brand

music.mood: energetic with a clear drop; the edit follows its sections

compliance: People recognisable in a commercial video agreed to it (staff, guests); children only with a guardian's consent
Event numbers on screen are real
Music licensed for commercial use; no chart track on a business account
Other brands' logos and artworks not featured without permission
